subject: Renewal pathway and HW migration playbook — BlueWing expansion
messages:
From: Jade Park <j.park@bluewing.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bluewing.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + Dedicated expansion request

Marissa,

Thanks for the catch-up last week. We're ready to move forward on the renewal but with two changes we need baked into the new term: a committed expansion (additional reserved pool) and a hardware-class migration from our current A100 fleet to H100/L40S for latency-sensitive workloads.

High level asks: 
- Add 75 additional reserved GPUs (mix: 50 H100, 25 L40S) on a 12-month committed term.
- Throughput SLA: baseline steady-state throughput guarantees for our inference pipelines (p95 token latency target 120ms for chat workloads).
- Help us justify perf-per-dollar vs staying on A100; procurement will need a cost/ROI memo.

Attached is a short internal note with our expected traffic profile and peak concurrency windows (bluewing-renewal-req-0702.pdf).

Can you outline how Redwood would approach the migration (canary, rollback, KV cache management) and what firm numbers we can commit to on throughput and cost? Procurement will want a single packaged quote + SOW.

Jade
Jade Park | CTO, BlueWing AI
From: marissa.cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jade Park <j.park@bluewing.ai>

Date: Sat, 3 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -07:00

Jade — thanks, this is clear and perfectly timed with your renewal window.

Quick reply: we can support the reserved pool add and H100/L40S migration during the renewal. I'll pull together a short migration playbook and perf-per-dollar memo for procurement. Karthik (cc'd) will own the technical bench and suggested SLAs; Neha will pull pricing options and SOW language.

1) Technical deep-dive call (30m) next week — Karthik to run perf scenarios.

3) Pilot plan for 10 H100s (2 weeks) to validate latency/throughput before full cutover.

I attached our standard renewal SOW template + preferred commercial term language to speed procurement (redwood-dedicated-renewal-sow-v3.pdf).

Would Tue or Wed next week work for the deep-dive?

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Dedicated expansion request — initial perf-per-dollar note

Marissa / team —

Following our internal benching and the quick profile Jade shared, key takeaways and a starter perf-per-dollar calculation (see attached hw-perf-dollar-summary-0706.xlsx and throughput-benchmarks-h100-vs-a100.xlsx):

Summary numbers (baseline):
- Workload: mix of chat + long-form generation; average sequence length 280 tokens, p95 sequence 640 tokens.
- A100 baseline (current): 1k sustained concurrent sessions (k80 equivalent), median token latency ~28ms, p95 ~160ms under current reserved pool utilization.
- H100 (recommended): median token latency ~18ms, p95 ~110ms under identical batching; effective throughput uplift 1.5x-1.9x depending on kernel optimizations.
- L40S (cost-optimized): median token latency ~22ms, p95 ~130ms, throughput uplift ~1.3x vs A100 for FP16/quantized models.

Perf-per-dollar:
- When normalized to cost/hour, H100 yields ~35-45% better tokens/sec per dollar for our model family (quantized + KV cache), L40S yields ~20-30% improvement. Exact delta depends on your token distribution (heavy long-form favors H100).

Operational considerations:
- Canary rollout: do 10 H100s with traffic shadowing + progressive cutover (10% → 50% → 100% of H100-eligible route).
- KV cache priming: we recommend an initial warm window (48–72h) with read-through cache enabled to hit steady-state before SLA kicks in.
- Autoscaling headroom: reserve burst buffer of 15% capacity for spiky windows; consider soft-limits on batch-size for latency-sensitive routes.

Suggested throughput guarantee for the committed pool (proposal):
- Reserved pool 50 H100 + 25 L40S: guaranteed tokens/sec per pool and p95 latency target of 120ms for specified routes.
- If we miss the SLA, crediting at a per-token rate or service credit is applied (we'll model exact credit table for procurement).

Attachments include the raw benchmark numbers and an initial cost model. I'll sync with Dev to produce the SLO language you can hand to legal.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachment: hw-perf-dollar-summary-0706.xlsx

From: Jade Park <j.park@bluewing.ai>

Subject: Re: Renewal + Dedicated expansion request — follow-up

Marissa / Karthik —

This looks good. Procurement and Legal have a couple of asks before we can commit:
1) Firmed pricing for the 12-month committed term with the 75-GPU add (line items for H100 vs L40S).
2) A pilot amendment for the initial 10 H100s with clear success criteria and rollback steps.
3) Draft SLA language and credit table if latency/throughput guarantees are missed.

On the migration approach, our infra team is comfortable with the canary + warm-window idea — we'd like the pilot to validate p95 < 120ms at 95th percentile traffic days. If that hits, procurement will expedite the contract.

Please include a one-page ROI memo showing 12-month TCO delta vs remaining on A100 (procurement prioritizes $/QPS and ops overhead).

If you can get a packaged quote + SOW + pilot amendment by next Friday (23 Jul), we'll turn around procurement review quickly.

Thanks,
Jade
